card.title: Who Cares More?
card.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry the heavier bag. I care more about your back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it for a while.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'd appear to care more about mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if I take the side with the books.

mechanism: A turns carrying weight and sharing proposals into a contest over who cares more for the other's comfort.
confusable: Unlike practical load balancing, A must preserve the heavier caring contribution as their own.
comparison: D91-b chooses the book-heavy side; D91-a chooses a waterproof cover to surpass the other's preserved tickets.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
